description: Lists what a character can do: the Do list's moves (wave hello, hop, bow...), each with the motion language's lines that play it (a does block plays one by id), and the motion language's own words (swim_to, hover, on_guard, sneak...) with their dials. category: humanoid, mammal, bird, fish or fantasy. q: words to match, or what a word means (dance finds Groove). Example: {"q": "wave", "category": "humanoid"}.

q.description: Words to look for ("wave", "dance"); leave it out for every move.

name: list_moves
title: List the moves and words a character can do
